title: Pure Light and Darkness Dragon
summary: The 2024 Light and Darkness Dragon cards with generic Level 8 Dragons and staples; the page's Chaos engine (Chaos Space, Seyfert, the Collapserpent pair) is left out. Light End Sublimation Dragon and Dark End Evaporation Dragon each summon themselves by banishing a Level 8 Dragon from the Extra Deck. Each one then Fusion Summons with the hand or field, and together they are the LIGHT and DARK materials for Light and Darkness Dragonlord. Dragonlord negates any activation by losing 1000 ATK and revives a Dragon when they destroy it. Dragon's Light and Darkness trades a Level 8 Dragon for one of the other Attribute. Knight Armed Dragon follows any big Dragon summon and copies a banished Dragon's Level. Nebula Dragon summons itself with another Level 8 Dragon from the hand. The Extra Deck is Level 8 Dragons to banish plus Rank 8 Dragons, because the summons lock you into Dragons.
